offering_description.value: Designs, engineers and manufactures emissions-certified, alternative-fuel and conventional internal combustion engines and power systems, plus related components. Sells to OEMs building industrial equipment, and to end users and distributors for power generation and aftermarket needs.

primary_products.value: natural gas and propane engines; gasoline and diesel engines; industrial power systems and generator set engines; aftermarket replacement parts; fuel systems and components

primary_services.value: aftermarket engine service and support; engineering and development services

customer_segment.value: B2B: OEMs of forklifts, generators, irrigation pumps, buses, trucks and industrial equipment, distributors and end users

end_markets.value: power generation; material handling; oil and gas; agriculture and irrigation; on-road vehicles; industrial equipment

revenue_model.value: product sales: engines, power systems and aftermarket parts sold to OEMs and distributors; service fees: engine service, support and engineering work

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: engineers and assembles engines from purchased blocks and components, sold to equipment OEMs and distributors; component supplier: supplies engines and parts as components for OEM equipment makers

geography_served.value: global: Primarily North America, with sales to customers in Europe, Asia and other regions

specialization.value: related lines: engines across fuel types, power systems and aftermarket parts for industrial and on-road uses

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct to large equipment OEM customers; distributors / dealers: authorized distributors for power systems and aftermarket parts

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: engine emissions certification under EPA and California Air Resources Board rules

notes: Details on current product mix are from memory and may be dated.
